tweets.text:
Last year, the Trustee appointed by OCIF alleged that Brent de Jong of Qenta was trying to steal $50 million from Euro Pacific Bank customers. I believe the actual amount is higher. But instead of filing an action aimed at recovering those funds, the Trustee filed a RICO lawsuit that falsely accused me of conspiring with de Jong. I believe he named me to smear me, even though I was the only one trying to get customers’ money back.

I believe the RICO lawsuit would have been dismissed. The Trustee ultimately settled with Qenta and voluntarily dismissed the case with prejudice. As part of the settlement, he released de Jong from all the claims he had asserted against him in the lawsuit, even though I believe de Jong was trying to steal customers’ money. I was not a party to the settlement, but the dismissal with prejudice applied to me as well.

It’s now been more than six months since the Trustee dismissed the lawsuit. Qenta is clearly in breach of the settlement, yet the Trustee has taken no action to enforce it. For example, Qenta agreed to pay all claims related to the bank’s mutual funds that are currently under its control, yet in over six months not one penny has been paid. Had I been given control of those funds, I would have returned them all in less than two weeks.

The Trustee is also in breach of his own agreement because he was required to demand that Qenta make up a $41 million shortfall to pay claims of customers who returned to the bank through reverse migration. Yet, to my knowledge, the Trustee has demanded that Qenta return only about $10 million of what is owed. My guess is that he hasn’t asked for the rest because he knows Qenta won’t pay and he doesn’t want to sue Qenta for breach.

During those six months, I’ve repeatedly urged the Trustee to take legal action against Qenta. I also asked him to authorize me to pursue recovery and offered to pay the legal costs out of my own pocket so the bank’s estate wouldn’t bear the expense. He has refused to act or to authorize me to pursue recovery in his place.
